R661.note: Standard hex-escape of LDAP metacharacters (*()\/NUL) closes the injection; benign input unaffected.

R662.note: Primary fix example (concatenated interpolated strings passed to ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync) does not compile (CS1503, verified with dotnet build) since '+' collapses the FormattableString to a plain string; the alternative SqlParameter fix given is correct and closes the vector.

R663.note: Removes the bogus second URL-decode and adds real canonicalization+containment check; intentional removal of double-decode support is explained plainly.

R664.note: Extension allowlist plus UUID renaming and size cap correctly closes the sink; disclosed narrowing of accepted types.

R665.note: Removes eval-based /e code injection but is_callable() still allows the attacker-chosen $formatter to be any real PHP function (e.g. system, exec), leaving arbitrary command execution reachable; no allowlist of safe formatter names is added.

R666.note: Magic-byte MIME check + UUID filename correctly closes the upload vector, but the file is renamed and the new name is never returned to the caller, silently breaking retrieval via the http.FileServer route present in the same file.

R667.note: Replaces BinaryFormatter with schema-bound System.Text.Json deserialization; narrowing to SessionData is the correct, disclosed defense.

R668.note: MIME+extension allowlist and UUID renaming close the sink; write-up explicitly flags that avatar_lookup.go's read-by-original-name path must be updated to match.

R669.note: fgets with sizeof(line) plus newline strip and capacity check correctly replaces gets(); no behavior change for legitimate short input.

R670.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores Django's default CSRF middleware protection; minimal, correct, disclosed.

R671.note: Allowlist regex on reportName plus ArgumentList closes the injection regardless of cmd.exe's batch re-parsing quirk (correctly caveated); fallback code compiles and uses the real run-report.bat.

R672.note: Narrow request DTO plus server-side IsAdmin/Balance correctly fixes the mass-assignment vector, but the write-up also silently switches the wire format from gob to JSON, breaking any existing gob-encoding clients when narrowing the gob-decoded struct would have sufficed.

R673.note: Swapping to FlaskForm adds Flask-WTF's built-in CSRF token validation on validate(), which works even though CSRFProtect(app) is never initialized in the app factory; correctly closes the reported sink.

R674.note: Removes the free from the error path and centralizes cleanup in the caller for both branches; restores single-owner model with no other observable change.

R675.note: Adds secure=True to the cookie; minimal, correct, exactly the missing attribute.

R676.note: Arithmetic-only allowlist regex plus removing the lookupRate function registration closes both the direct eval injection and the file-read escalation, but silently drops rule expressions' ability to call lookupRate at all (only offered as an unregistered standalone method, disclosed as a caveat).

R677.note: Magic-byte validation via file-type is the right approach, but the code uses require('file-type'), and current published file-type (v17+) is pure ESM and throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM under require(), so the exact fix as written would fail at runtime.

R678.note: th:text is the correct escaping API and fully closes the XSS, but it also disables all HTML rendering of the bodyHtml field entirely (the field the case models as intentionally-HTML content); disclosed with a sanitizer-based alternative for when rich HTML is actually required.

R679.note: Wraps the route with the existing requireAdmin middleware, matching the pattern used elsewhere; minimal and correct.

R680.note: Adds the missing password comparison before authenticating; offers a sensible bcrypt fallback given the User model isn't in scope.

R681.note: Switches to HttpPost with ValidateAntiForgeryToken, the standard ASP.NET Core CSRF defense for state-changing actions; the required form/token change is disclosed.

R682.note: ProcessBuilder array args close shell-metacharacter injection, but host/count are passed unvalidated as direct ping.exe arguments; an attacker-supplied host like "-t" is read as the continuous-ping flag rather than a target, causing an indefinite hang/DoS - argument-injection is not addressed.

R683.note: Generates one $n placeholder per id and passes ids as the parameter array; correct pg parameterization, same result semantics.

R684.note: Re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] after push_back instead of reusing the stale reference; correctly avoids the UAF with identical output.

R685.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml is Microsoft's documented XXE mitigation for XmlDocument; no functional change for legitimate XML.

R686.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized filterArgs (RFC 4515 auto-escaping) instead of manual escaping; placeholder renumbering is consistent and correct.

R687.note: Parameterized query with driver-bound placeholder correctly replaces fmt.Sprintf concatenation; output format unchanged.

R688.note: Captures bytesSent() before reset() destroys the Resource; matches the function's documented intent exactly, no behavior change.

R689.note: toRealPath() canonicalization plus Path.startsWith containment check correctly closes traversal while preserving the existing catch-and-report error handling.

R690.note: Replaces unserialize() with json_decode() plus a safe default; correctly notes the paired encode() side (not in the given files) must also change.

R691.note: enable_shared_from_this plus capturing shared_ptr in the lambda is the standard fix for a raw `this` capture outliving its object in an async queue; no observable behavior change.

R692.note: SqlCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue replaces string.Format concatenation; correct, minimal, same query semantics.

R693.note: mysql2 execute() with a ? placeholder and args array is a true prepared statement; same callback shape and output.

R694.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities() on both user-controlled fields correctly closes the XSS; correctly leaves the server-generated status badge untouched.

R695.note: Parameterized JNDI search (filterArgs + explicit default SearchControls) matches the original null-SearchControls default scope; correct escaping fix.

R696.note: jwt.verify() with a pinned HS256 algorithm list and try/catch replaces unverified jwt.decode(); 401 on invalid signature is the correct, disclosed consequence.

R697.note: Passing null for envp (inherit parent environment) removes the attacker-controlled environment array entirely; no legitimate use of that array existed to preserve.

R698.note: Swaps libxmljs for xml2js/sax-js, which never implements DTD/external-entity resolution, structurally closing XXE; result extraction is adapted to the new API and preserves the same response shape.

R699.note: Drops the reference entirely and re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] on every access, avoiding the dangling reference across push_back; correct, minimal.

R700.note: keyFunc now type-asserts SigningMethodHMAC and WithValidMethods([]string{"HS256"}) adds parser-level enforcement, closing the alg-confusion/none vector with no change for legitimately-signed tokens.
